description: This Java source file defines a class 'ThingModifyCommandResponseMappingStrategies' that provides mapping strategies for different types of 'thing modify' command responses in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains methods to initialize and add specific response mappings based on response types, enabling transformed responses in the system.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandResponseMappingStrategies
classes.description: Provides static methods to initialize and manage response mapping strategies for various 'thing modify' responses in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Creates a map of response type strings to corresponding JsonifiableMapper functions, initializing all response strategies.

methods.name: addTopLevelResponses
methods.description: Adds response mappings for top-level 'thing' creation, modification, deletion, and policy ID change responses.

methods.name: addAclResponses
methods.description: Adds response mappings related to ACL (Access Control List) modifications and deletions.

methods.name: addAttributeResponses
methods.description: Adds response mappings for attribute modifications, creations, and deletions.

methods.name: addDefinitionResponses
methods.description: Adds response mappings for thing definition creation and deletion responses.

methods.name: addFeatureResponses
methods.description: Adds response mappings related to features and feature properties, including creation, modification, deletion, and definitions.
